I keep running into dependency conflicts between OpenPNM and PoreSpy. Is there a definitive compatibility matrix?

Accepted Answer (137 upvotes):

OpenPNM 3.3.x -> PoreSpy 2.3.x
OpenPNM 3.4.x -> PoreSpy 2.4.x
OpenPNM 3.5.x -> PoreSpy 2.5.x (beta)

The minor releases have to stay synced. You cannot use openpnm 3.5.2 with porespy 2.4.3.

Specific working combinations:
- openpnm==3.4.0 with porespy==2.4.0
- openpnm==3.4.1 with porespy==2.4.1
- openpnm==3.4.2 with porespy==2.4.2
- openpnm==3.3.0 with porespy==2.3.0

Always check the compatibility note: https://porespy.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html

pip uninstall openpnm porespy -y
pip install openpnm==X.Y.Z porespy==A.B.C
